name: Go Bankrupt Because of Your Son
desc:
- You are peacefully watching TV when you notice your wallet is gone. You ask your son about it and you discover he wasted all your money on Roblox pets.
- Your quest is to try to get that money back before it's too late. Rob a bank, get a job, become a soccer player, steal from your neighbour, join the military, mine some diamonds and much more!
- Comedy/Meme adventure game.

Thank you all for the suport ❤️

Like👍 and Favorite⭐ The game if you enjoy!
